doc:
An element `p` of a commutative monoid with zero (e.g., a ring) is called *prime*,
if it's not zero, not a unit, and `p ∣ a * b → p ∣ a ∨ p ∣ b` for all `a`, `b`.
statement: {M : Type u_1} → [CommMonoidWithZero M] → M → Prop
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M] {p : M}, Prime p → p ≠ 0
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M] {p : M}, Prime p → ¬IsUnit p
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M] {p : M}, Prime p → ¬p ∣ 1
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M] {p : M}, Prime p → p ≠ 1
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M] {p : M}, Prime p → ∀ {a b : M}, p ∣ a * b → p ∣ a ∨ p ∣ b
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M] {p : M}, Prime p → ∀ {a b : M}, p ∣ a * b ↔ p ∣ a ∨ p ∣ b
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M] {p : M}, Prime p → IsPrimal p
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M] {p : M}, Prime p → ∀ {a b : M}, ¬p ∣ a → ¬p ∣ b → ¬p ∣ a * b
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M] {p : M}, Prime p → ∀ {a : M} {n : ℕ}, p ∣ a ^ n → p ∣ a
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M] {p : M}, Prime p → ∀ {a : M} {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → (p ∣ a ^ n ↔ p ∣ a)
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M], ¬Prime 0
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M], ¬Prime 1
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoid M] {p u : M}, Irreducible p → IsUnit u → ¬p ∣ u
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoid M] {p : M}, Irreducible p → ¬p ∣ 1
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoid M] {p : M} (u : Mˣ), Irreducible p → ¬p ∣ ↑u
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoid M] {p a : M}, Irreducible p → a * a ∣ p → IsUnit a
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M], ¬Irreducible 0
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M] {p : M}, Irreducible p → p ≠ 0

doc: If `p` and `q` are irreducible, then `p ∣ q` implies `q ∣ p`.
statement: ∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : Monoid M] {p q : M}, Irreducible p → Irreducible q → p ∣ q → q ∣ p
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : Monoid M] {p q : M}, Irreducible p → Irreducible q → (p ∣ q ↔ q ∣ p)
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M] {a : M}, Irreducible a → IsPrimal a → Prime a
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M] [DecompositionMonoid M] {a : M}, Irreducible a → Prime a
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M] [IsCancelMulZero M] {p : M}, Prime p → Irreducible p

∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero M] [IsCancelMulZero M] [DecompositionMonoid M] {a : M},
  Irreducible a ↔ Prime a
